newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia Apex Equity in Philippine deal.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia Apex Equity in Philippine deal.

text.p: Apex Equity Holdings Bhd said it has entered into an agreement with Philippine conglomerate TDG to subscribe for 80 percent in Apex Philippines Equities Corp for 8.0 million ringgit.
The subsription is for 750,000 common shares or a 75 percent stake plus the right to subscribe for another five percent in Apex Philippines, the Malaysian stockbroking concern said in a statement.
The transaction would result in Apex Philippines becoming a subsidiary of Apex Equity, it said.
Apex Philippines is a member of the Philippines Stock Exchange and located in Makati. An official at Apex Equity had no further information about TDG.
Apex Equity said the proposed subscription would enable it to expand its stockbroking business to the Philippines. The proposed deal is subject to the approval of relevant Philippines authorities.
Apex Equity's stock was suspended from February 21 pending a news announcement. It was requoted on Tuesday and was off 60 cents to 20.10 ringgit at the end of morning trading.
